name: screenshot-annotate-share
description: Shows Boss what is on his Mac screen: captures it the one way that renders inline in chat, then points precisely at the part he asked about — in words, and by re-framing a second shot on it. Use when Boss asks what is on his screen, to show him a window, or to look at something he cannot see from his phone.
whenNotToUse: Driving an app rather than looking at it → mac-ai-app-operator. Command output he wants to see → run the command and paste the lines; a picture of a terminal is worse than the text. Tidying files → mac-file-organizer.
stopConditions: স্ক্রিনে পাসওয়ার্ড/OTP/কী/ব্যাংক নম্বর দেখা যাচ্ছে — পড়ে শোনানো নয়
ছবিটা এল না বা পড়া গেল না — আন্দাজে বর্ণনা নয়
